visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up shot of a person's hands holding a silver smartphone, scrolling through a YouTube channel page titled '電獺少女'. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot of a young woman with long, dark hair and purple-tinted ends, wearing a dark brown sleeveless top and blue jeans, sitting on a lime-green chair in a well-lit indoor room with beige curtains. (3) A close-up shows the phone screen displaying a messaging app with cartoon stickers; a finger taps the screen. (4) The woman looks up at the camera with a surprised expression, then holds her phone toward the viewer. (5) A plush otter toy is held up to the camera, appearing to 'talk'. (6) The camera focuses on a white table with a laptop; hands are seen pressing keys on a Windows laptop, causing an emoji picker window to appear over a web browser. (7) The woman is seen sitting at the desk, gesturing with her hands towards the computer. (8) The camera shifts to a silver MacBook on the same desk; the otter plush is partially visible behind the screen. (9) A close-up of the woman's hands pressing the 'fn' key on the MacBook, triggering another emoji menu. (10) The woman stares into the camera with a frustrated expression, then proceeds to shake and 'strangle' the otter plush. (11) The final shot is a black-and-white still image of the otter plush inside a black mourning frame with a black ribbon, centered on a black background.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a short, humorous tech tip intended to teach viewers how to quickly access the emoji menu on both Windows (Win + .) and Mac (fn) operating systems. It uses a comedic dialogue between a human host and a plush otter to make the technical information more engaging and shareable.
